text: AKS, the HPA, and the NetworkPolicy are planned. Last piece before implementation: how Fairmont Grain watches what this platform costs, and whether it's healthy.
An Azure Cost Management budget alerts at 80% and 100% of eighteen thousand a month -- routed to an action group that actually reaches the on-call channel.
One reliability dashboard, four panels: cost trend, AKS replica count, Azure SQL load, and grain-ingest's own request rate -- deliberately on the same screen.
The design principle: a correctly-scaled system should cost more because it's doing more real work. Cost up with database load flat is a visible mismatch, not a hidden one.
The architecture is fully planned. Next: opening Terraform for real and provisioning the core infrastructure.
